question: Sankalp Gupta is associated with which of the following events?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chess**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sankalp Gupta is a renowned chess player from India.
 
• He achieved the title of International Master (IM) in chess.
 
• Gupta has participated in several national and international chess tournaments, showcasing his strategic skills.
 
• He is known for his analytical prowess and has contributed to the growth of chess in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chess Terminologies and Titles:**

 
 
• **International Master (IM):** This is a high-level title awarded by the World Chess Federation (FIDE). It is one step below the Grandmaster (GM) title.
 
• **Grandmaster (GM):** The highest title awarded in chess, signifying a player of exceptional skill and achievement.
 
• **FIDE:** Fédération Internationale des Échecs or International Chess Federation, the governing body of international chess competition.
 
• **Chess Rating:** A system used by FIDE to estimate the strength of players, based on their performance in tournaments.
 
 
 
• **History of Chess in India:**
 
 
• Chess, known as "Chaturanga" in ancient India, has deep roots in Indian history.
 
• India has produced several notable chess players including Viswanathan Anand, the former World Chess Champion.
 
• The All India Chess Federation (AICF) governs the sport in India, promoting and organizing chess activities across the nation.
 
 
 
• **Chess Strategies:**
 
 
• **Opening:** The initial phase of the game where players develop their pieces and control the center of the board.
 
• **Middle Game:** The phase where players engage in tactical maneuvers and strategic planning.
 
• **Endgame:** The final phase where the number of pieces is reduced, and players aim to checkmate the opponent’s king.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Chess:**
 
 
• Chess improves cognitive skills such as memory, problem-solving, and critical thinking.
 
• It enhances concentration and patience among players.
 
• Playing chess promotes strategic and analytical thinking, beneficial for various aspects of life.
